meta.name: to-tickets
meta.description: Break a plan, spec, or the current conversation into a set of tracer-bullet tickets, each declaring its blocking edges, published to the configured tracker — edges as text in a local file, or native blocking links on a real tracker.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将计划或讨论拆解为可执行的工单
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果常需将需求或讨论转化为可追踪的工单
copy.tagline_en: Break plans or discussions into actionable tickets
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to turn requirements or discussions into trackable tickets

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 能将计划、规格或当前对话拆解成一组可独立演示的“追踪子弹”工单，每个工单标明其依赖的阻塞工单，并发布到配置好的工单追踪系统（本地文件或真实追踪器）。
howto.when: 当你提供计划、规格或讨论内容，并希望将其转化为可执行的工单时触发。

say.text: 把这个功能需求拆成工单，标出阻塞关系。
say.note: Claude 会生成工单列表并询问你的意见。

say.text: 把当前对话中的任务分解成工单。
say.note: Claude 会基于对话内容生成工单。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can break a plan, spec, or current conversation into a set of tracer-bullet tickets, each declaring its blocking edges, and publish them to the configured tracker (local file or real tracker).
howto.when_en: Triggered when you provide a plan, spec, or discussion content and want to convert it into actionable tickets.

say_en.text: Break this feature request into tickets with blocking edges.
say_en.note: Claude will generate a ticket list and ask for your feedback.

say_en.text: Decompose the current conversation into tickets.
say_en.note: Claude will generate tickets based on the conversation.
